intro.title: Meet your Character
intro.description1: Upload the best photos of yourself with varied <highlight>expressions</highlight>, <highlight>angles</highlight>, and <highlight>poses</highlight> to shape your unique AI twin!
intro.description2: Like a real photoshoot, a little prep delivers authentic, pro-level results.
intro.privacy: Your uploads are private and secure.

confirmation.title: Like a real photo shoot, <highlight>a little prep</highlight> goes a long way.
confirmation.paragraph1: Primeshot creates high quality portraits from your everyday photos. Clear, well lit, and varied photos make your generated shoots more natural and impressive. Low quality or blurry photos can limit results.
confirmation.paragraph2: If results are not what you expected, try a new set of photos in a fresh Character.

naturalLight.title: Natural Light
naturalLight.description: Use well-lit photos by a window or outside! Avoid dark or blurry for sharp results.

angles.title: Angles
angles.description: Mix it up with angles! Pick shoulder-ups, front and side, add a few waist-ups.

expressions.title: Expressions
expressions.description: Express your vibe with varied smiles, poses. Skip same-face for dynamic shots.

variety.title: Variety
variety.description: Pick shots with a mix of clothing and backgrounds. Skip heavy filters.
